from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import ProjectDocument

@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def broadcast_cursor_selection(request, doc_id):
    doc = ProjectDocument.objects.get(id=doc_id, workspace=request.user.workspace)
    selection_text = request.data.get('selected_text')
    cursor_pos = request.data.get('cursor_pos')

    # Broadcasts selection details to broad workspace group instead of per-document group
    channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
    async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
        f"workspace_{request.user.workspace.id}_active",
        {
            'type': 'editor.cursor_moved',
            'user': request.user.email,
            'doc_id': doc.id,
            'selected_text': selection_text,
            'cursor_pos': cursor_pos
        }
    )

diagnosis: broadcast_cursor_selection broadcasts live text selection snippets and cursor movements to f"workspace_{workspace.id}_active". Although the document is protected inside the workspace, confidential documents (such as executive meeting notes) have restricted document-level collaborator lists. Broadcasting text snippets to the entire workspace group leaks confidential clauses to workspace members who are not granted access to that document.

from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import ProjectDocument

@api_view(['POST'])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def broadcast_cursor_selection(request, doc_id):
    doc = ProjectDocument.objects.get(id=doc_id, workspace=request.user.workspace)
    selection_text = request.data.get('selected_text')
    cursor_pos = request.data.get('cursor_pos')

    # Isolate real-time cursor events strictly to users permitted on this specific document
    channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
    async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
        f"doc_{doc.id}_collaborators",
        {
            'type': 'editor.cursor_moved',
            'user': request.user.email,
            'doc_id': doc.id,
            'selected_text': selection_text,
            'cursor_pos': cursor_pos
        }
    )
    return Response({'status': 'broadcasted'})
